values.note: Two drive-in campgrounds: Holly Point 158 sites (89 electric/water) and Rolling View 115 (80 electric/water), plus 46 hike-in tent sites at Shinleaf and tent-only group camps. The booking site lists back-ins and some pull-throughs, driveways mostly 30-100 ft.

summary: Existing fees ($30 / +$10 electric) and season (Rolling View Loop A year-round) stand. Added 50-amp electric + water, 273 drive-in sites across Holly Point and Rolling View with some pull-throughs, dump stations, 6-month window and the booking site's holiday minimum (waived within 14 days, not the agency row's 7). Holly Point is closed for wastewater construction until November 16, 2026 (a partial closure; Rolling View operates). Not stated: showers by name, max stay.
flags: Entry covers the whole SRA and the pin (36.0230,-78.6994) sits on no campground: 0.84 km from the Highway 50 Access boat ramp, 3.1 km from Rolling View Campground (ncparks GPS 36.0085,-78.7291) and 4.0 km from Holly Point Campground (36.0100,-78.6575). AWH's note ('Wooded campground with multiple lakefront RV sites') fits either; the season already recorded follows Rolling View's Loop A (open year-round), and Holly Point is closed for construction until 2026-11-16. Suggest narrowing to Rolling View (115 sites, 80 electric, year-round Loop A) and re-pinning, with Holly Point (158 sites, 89 electric) as its own entry if wanted. B.W. Wells and Shinleaf are tent/group or hike-in only.
